poi_torremolinos_molino_inca.description: An old spring and watermill turned into a botanical garden, with ponds, waterfalls, birds and over a thousand plant species. A green oasis few tourists know.
poi_torremolinos_molino_inca.short_tip: Entry €3 (€1 for registered residents). Perfect to escape the summer heat.

poi_msb1rniw_077bzs.name: Casa de los Navajas
poi_msb1rniw_077bzs.description: A 1925 neo-Mudéjar mansion overlooking the sea above Bajondillo beach, with tiles, latticework and gardens. It hosts exhibitions.
poi_msb1rniw_077bzs.short_tip: Free entry. Open Wednesday to Sunday.

iglesia-san-miguel.name: Church of San Miguel Arcángel
iglesia-san-miguel.description: Torremolinos' oldest parish church, from the 18th century, at the top of Calle San Miguel, where the old village of fishermen and millers began.
iglesia-san-miguel.short_tip: Free entry. Fits nicely into a stroll down Calle San Miguel.

centro-cultural-picasso.name: Pablo Ruiz Picasso Cultural Centre
centro-cultural-picasso.description: A municipal centre with temporary art exhibitions, theatre and concerts in the middle of Torremolinos.
centro-cultural-picasso.short_tip: Exhibitions are free. Check the programme.

mirador-canada-lobo.name: Cañada del Lobo Viewpoint
mirador-canada-lobo.description: In the hills above Torremolinos, with a wide view of the coast from Málaga to Benalmádena.
mirador-canada-lobo.short_tip: Wear comfortable shoes: the last stretch is a footpath.

el-morro.name: El Morro (Punta de Torremolinos)
el-morro.description: The headland between Bajondillo beach and La Carihuela, with a viewpoint over the whole Bay of Málaga.
el-morro.short_tip: The coastal path goes around it: a great sunset walk.
